S1.title: Inbox empty
S1.user_action: Upload a file from the launch popup

S2.title: Inbox has inputs
S2.user_action: Choose an input tile; toggle auto-approve

S3.title: Input already ran
S3.user_action: Read the tile's warning naming the runs; start anyway

S4.title: Another run active
S4.user_action: Launch is locked; follow the link to the active run

S5.title: Bad upload (name, exists)
S5.user_action: Read the error; the other files continue

S6.title: Choose the language
S6.user_action: Keep the catalog default or type another code

R1.title: Watch a running run
R1.user_action: Watch the live graph, metrics and logs

R2.title: Inspect any node
R2.user_action: Open a node: facts, findings, artifacts, error

R3.title: Stop the run
R3.user_action: Press stop, confirm in place; status becomes stopped

A3.title: Approval: free-text answer
A3.user_action: Type an answer and send; the node re-plans and may ask again

A4.title: Approval answered on Telegram
A4.user_action: Nothing: the console reflects the answer

A5.title: Unknown curator action (ALREADY_PROCESSED)
A5.user_action: Answer the question the curator asks instead of a crash

E2.title: Node error, recoverable: retry fails again
E2.user_action: Asked again: press Retry or Abort

E3.title: Node error, recoverable: abort
E3.user_action: Press Abort; the run is failed

E4.title: Node error, non-recoverable
E4.user_action: Read the reason; only Abort is offered

E5.title: No answer before the reminder budget
E5.user_action: Nothing: the run ends failed, then the failed branch applies

E6.title: Run waits under an old release with no pending.json
E6.user_action: Read the reason; stop is offered

F1.title: Failed
F1.user_action: Read reason and node; retry from checkpoint

F2.title: Crashed (dead pid)
F2.user_action: Read the reason; retry from checkpoint

F4.title: Any ended-not-ok run
F4.user_action: Restart from scratch with the same input

F5.title: Input file gone
F5.user_action: Restart is refused with the reason

F6.title: No checkpoint
F6.user_action: Retry is refused with the reason

D2.title: Verdict PARTIAL/FAIL
D2.user_action: Read the failing checks; the output stays usable

D3.title: Read every output in place
D3.user_action: Read thumbnail, blog, KB entry, research, audit and artifacts

D4.title: Edit a text output in place
D4.user_action: Edit blog, KB or any text artifact and save

D5.title: Open research
D5.user_action: Follow an http link or a local book; a row with no link says so

P3.title: Package pending: edit
P3.user_action: Edit fields and save without publishing

P4.title: Package pending: publish
P4.user_action: Press publish; publishing; published with link

P5.title: Publish failed
P5.user_action: Read the error, edit, publish again

P7.title: Cannot prepare (no video, no blog post)

P8.title: Validation error
P8.user_action: Read the per-field error and correct it

P10.title: Auto mode
P10.user_action: Read published or failed; no action unless failed

P12.title: Video the browser cannot decode
P12.user_action: Nothing: a converted copy swaps in; read the reason and retry if it failed

N1.title: Needs-you bar
N1.user_action: Read every run wanting a decision; one click to it

levels.unit: Hash routing lives entirely in views.js and app.js; there is no Python to unit test.
levels.integration: The server never sees the hash fragment; a route test could not reach this branch.

N3.title: Output navigation
N3.user_action: Section nav, keyboard, no long scroll, full width

levels.unit: Section nav, keys and layout live entirely in js/output and CSS; there is no Python to unit test.
levels.integration: The server is not involved: nav, keys and geometry exist only in the browser.

N4.title: Graph navigation
N4.user_action: Zoom, pan, fit; the panel never hides the graph

levels.unit: Zoom, pan, fit and docking live entirely in dag.js, drawer.js and CSS; there is no Python to unit test.
levels.integration: The server is not involved: this is pointer input and geometry, which exist only in the browser.

levels.unit: The badge lives entirely in app.js and api.js; there is no Python to unit test.
levels.integration: The premise is that the server does not answer, so a route test has nothing to call.

S7.title: Dashboard is home
S7.user_action: Open the console, go anywhere, come back

S8.user_action: Start the first run from the dashboard

D8.user_action: Delete it; the input can run again

D10.user_action: Read what the videos were about
